note: Neutral-current single-pion production nu N -> nu p pi- off deuterium at the ANL 12-ft bubble chamber (Derrick et al.). Absolute total cross section sigma(E_nu) for the exclusive NC channel nu p -> nu p pi- (proton + pi-). This is the only genuine cross-section table NUISANCE ships for this channel (ANL_NC1ppim_Enu_xsec.csv); the companion ANL_NC1ppim_cosMuStar.csv is a shape distribution with no uncertainties and is excluded. Target: bound nucleon in deuterium; values in 10^-41 cm^2.
provenance: Derrick:1980nr - ANL 12-ft NC single-pion production on deuterium; total cross section sigma(E_nu) for nu N -> nu p pi- - from the NUISANCE data release
